text: The Clear Group, the UK independent insurance broker, is owned by Private Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives; Business Insurance separately reports that Clear Insurance Management Ltd. is majority owned by The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
short: The Clear Group is owned by Goldman Sachs (Private Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives).

source.name: Insurance Journal — Clear Group Acquires Lilley Plummer Risks, Entering Wholesale Lloyd's Broker Space
source.quote: Clear Group, the UK independent insurance broker that is owned by Private Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, has entered the wholesale Lloyd’s broker space

additionalSources.name: Business Insurance — Clear Group buys Lilley Plummer Holdings from B.P. Marsh
additionalSources.quote: U.K.-based chartered insurance broker Clear Insurance Management Ltd., majority owned by The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., has acquired specialist Lloyd’s broker Lilley Plummer Holdings Ltd.
